inputs.name: changes of state of work objects on every surface the organisation connects, within each surface's signed grant and the classes of act it set as formal: letters and formal e-mail in and out, the organisation's own posts, requests between units and entities, changes of state on its task tracker and knowledge base, formal channels of its team chat, merges and releases on its code hosts, meetings of its decision bodies
inputs.format: surface event (home reference, state, time, content hash), received through the tool gateway; every person field removed at the Input socket before any write

inputs.name: hand-offs between AI units and the root of each gateway log segment
inputs.format: gateway record (Cell codes, payload hash, segment root), read only from the tool gateway's log

inputs.name: register first: the tool gateway's request for a number before it releases a formal outgoing item
inputs.format: registration request (metadata and content hash at release); the number from the numbering service

inputs.name: a position's request to keep an entry, or to file an item of its personal mailbox
inputs.format: file request, through the HU input port

inputs.name: from Source Lifecycle: references only (ID, version, status, held or not held) of the sources its entries cite, under its signed grant, never content; and notices of supersession, revocation or reclassification for every version an entry cites
inputs.format: source reference and notice (ID + version), received through the tool gateway

outputs.name: one numbered, hash-chained register entry for each crossing of a formal act, by reference to its home and the SHA-256 of its content; never the content, and never a natural person
outputs.format: append-only event (number from the numbering service; previous and own hash)

outputs.name: an inbox and an outbox for every unit and position, and the live state of each position's own open items
outputs.format: Panel projection, rebuilt from the events

outputs.name: what each part had and what it lacked: coverage, links, orphan merges, answers on time, work done with a source, late registration, closures with no reason, refusals; by entity, unit, process and AI Cell, never for one human position
outputs.format: projection with its logic version, each figure traced to its events

outputs.name: to Source Lifecycle: correspondence a position asked to keep; the projection of the work by role-type and process, after the data-protection decision (HF-17); gap signals
outputs.format: filings within its write scope, and Work Items (ID + version), sent through the tool gateway

outputs.name: evidence packs verified by hash; a position's handover list of open entries and commitments; pseudonymised case packs
outputs.format: versioned packs (manifest + hashes), sent through the tool gateway

outputs.name: integrity findings: number gaps, census differences, rebuild differences, missing segment anchors
outputs.format: Work Item (ID + version) to the accountable seat and the internal-audit line

tool_roles: surface adapters, one per surface type (mail, letters, social accounts, code hosts, task tracker, knowledge base, team chat, calendars)
append-only event store with a hash chain
tool gateway (connections, register first, the stop door)
